facts.fact: The ministry's October 2018 presentation sets the Stratégie Tunisie Digitale 2020 targets for 2020 (100% of homes connected, 13,500 MTND digital value added, 5,000 MTND digital exports) after a five-year plan started in 2015.

The presentation lists an implementation plan with dated 2018 and 2020 targets per axis (infrastructure, e-government, e-business, Smart Tunisia) and a selection of named projects; it states no costs.

The ministry's 'Réalisations et objectifs' table gives 2014-2017 outturns against the strategy's targets for digital value added, digital exports, jobs created, connected homes and mobile broadband penetration (e.g. 44.5% of homes connected in 2017 against 100% for 2020), with several 2017 values marked ND; it covers some axes only.

The presentation's governance chart gives the CSEN (Conseil stratégique de l'économie numérique) the validation of the strategy, arbitration and recommendations to support implementation, above a steering committee and per-programme project offices in the ministries.
